segments.title: 第190章 貼身
segments.content:
Up Close and Personal

The living room of the house in Bihai Lanting was quite large.

At this moment, Li Luo stood in the center of the living room, facing the balcony. To his left, near the kitchen, was the dining table they usually ate at.

And to his right was the long sofa facing the wall. Li Luo could still hear the dialogue from the TV show playing.

Directly in front of him was a large, long table that Lin Xiuhong had specifically bought earlier.

Usually, when they wanted to study together, they would gather here.

If you had to ask if there were any good hiding spots, there really weren't any.

It was only after putting on the blindfold that the game was given some room for strategy.

But for Li Luo, the blindfold only made it so he couldn't see.

With the empowerment from his memory palace's soul, he could walk with perfect accuracy, replicating his usual movements around the living room.

However, to avoid being accused of cheating, Li Luo still pretended to be cautious, stretching out his hands to start fumbling around.

By now, the other five had already found their spots.

Among them, Zhao Rongjun was the most honest. He just sat on the single armchair by the TV, hugging a pillow, looking as if he'd accepted that life and death were fated, with no intention of hiding at all.

Qiao Xinyan had crouched down under the desk, even pulling two chairs to block the front and back as obstacles.

Ying Chanxi hid behind the curtains.

Xu Youyu simply dove under the coffee table, curling herself into a ball, not forgetting to peek her head out to observe the enemy.

Yan Zhusheng wasn't very good at this kind of game and just quietly squatted in the corner by the piano room door.

Once the game began, Li Luo had no intention of finishing it quickly. He slowly groped his way through some of the common areas first.

Holding onto the back of the long sofa, he explored all the way to the desk, and under Qiao Xinyan's nervous gaze, he arrived at the balcony curtains.

Ying Chanxi was so nervous she squatted down inside the curtains, revealing only one eye to watch Li Luo pass by her, a mix of tension and excitement.

But in the end, Xu Youyu was still the better player.

As Li Luo passed by the coffee table, she dared to sneak a foot out and give his calf a light kick.

This made Li Luo stop at once.

This position... Li Luo knew he was standing in front of the TV, with just a coffee table next to him, and yet he got kicked in the calf here... A simple analysis told him where this mischievous person was hiding.

Li Luo chuckled. He decided not to move and simply started feeling around the coffee table.

After he had felt all over the top of the table and found no one, he deliberately avoided checking underneath it.

Hiding underneath, Xu Youyu's face was filled with excitement. Her breathing became a little ragged as she stared intently at Li Luo's feet walking around the coffee table.

As time passed, Li Luo slowly crouched down and began to try reaching his hand under the coffee table.

At this moment, according to the rules they had agreed on, Xu Youyu kept one leg under the table without moving, then rolled her upper body and tumbled out from the other side of the coffee table.

And so, Li Luo's hand grasped at empty air, touching only the cold floor.

This surprised Li Luo for a moment.

But he soon realized what had happened. He silently withdrew his hand, stood up, and pretended that since he hadn't found anyone, he was going to search somewhere else.

At this point, the others watching couldn't help but wipe away a cold sweat.

Zhao Rongjun, hugging his pillow on the armchair, had a close-up view of the whole exchange between Li Luo and Xu Youyu.

Luckily, Li Luo never thought someone would be sitting on the armchair, so he didn't even grope in that direction. Otherwise, a casual reach of his hand would have caught Zhao Rongjun directly.

It could only be said that the most dangerous place was sometimes also the safest.

But just when everyone thought Li Luo had given up on searching under the coffee table, and Xu Youyu had crawled back underneath, Li Luo's feet, which had just moved away from the table, suddenly changed direction as he whipped back around for a surprise attack.

"Ah!"

Xu Youyu was startled by his returning left hand. She didn't even have time to block it before Li Luo's hand, reaching under the coffee table, caught her.

But the next second, both the one who caught and the one who was caught froze, silent.

Because their view was blocked by the coffee table, the others didn't know what had happened underneath. They all just breathed a sigh of relief, releasing the tense state of holding their breath.

"That scared me to death," Ying Chanxi said as she walked over. "You have no idea, you almost caught me just now. I was just squatting behind the curtains, and you didn't even think to check down there."

"And Zhao Rongjun, hahaha, he was sitting on the armchair the whole time, and you never felt around up there. You couldn't even find him, but you went straight for the trickiest spot under the coffee table."

"Look at Zhusheng, she's been squatting over there the whole time, just watching you and Senior battle wits. It was hilarious."

While Ying Chanxi was cheerfully recapping for him, Zhao Rongjun looked at Li Luo, then at Xu Youyu, and opened his mouth, unsure if he had seen correctly just now.

Li Luo, however, silently took off the blindfold and looked down at his own left hand. A strange glint flashed in his eyes, as if he was feeling a bit guilty.

Fortunately, Xu Youyu didn't say anything. She just crawled out from under the coffee table, stared at Li Luo meaningfully for a few seconds, then took out the lipstick and handed it to him. "Here, punish me."

"Ahem..." Li Luo didn't quite dare to meet Xu Youyu's gaze. After taking the lipstick, he hastily and randomly drew a line on her face, considering the punishment done. Then he immediately stuffed the blindfold into Xu Youyu's hands. "Senior, you're up."

"Hmph."

Xu Youyu snorted softly, straightened out her somewhat messy clothes, put on the blindfold, and stood in the center of the living room. "Let's go. Remember to set a timer."

"It's set." Li Luo set two timers on his phone, then began to look for a suitable hiding place.

But before he could even start looking, Ying Chanxi grabbed him and pulled him over to the curtains by the balcony, pulling him directly in front of her.

"Hey... isn't this a bit much?" Li Luo whispered in Ying Chanxi's ear. "Using me as a human shield?"

"Aiya, it's very safe here. I'm doing this for your own good," Ying Chanxi said with a giggle, forcefully pulling him into the curtains with her. The two of them were squeezed together.

When Yan Zhusheng saw this, she, who hadn't known where to hide, followed them and squeezed in as well.

"Zhusheng, what are you doing in here?" Ying Chanxi was instantly dumbfounded and quickly whispered, "Three people is a bit too many."

"It's okay." Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "I'll be the shield on the very outside. If she feels for someone, she'll get me first, so you'll both be safe."

Li Luo: "..."

Ying Chanxi: "..."

Zhao Rongjun, who had switched from the armchair to lying on the long sofa, was stunned when he saw the human sandwich by the curtains.

And Qiao Xinyan, who had hidden under the coffee table this time, had a similar expression to Zhao Rongjun's when she peeked her head out and saw the scene by the curtains.

Then, one under the coffee table and one on the sofa, the two of them looked at each other, at a loss for words.

Qiao Xinyan couldn't help but chuckle. She pointed at the curtains and covered her mouth, snickering.

Zhao Rongjun threw up his hands, indicating that he was just as speechless.

At that moment, the 30-second alarm on the phone rang.

Xu Youyu chuckled and, after turning off the alarm, sprang into action. "Just you wait. Watch me make short work of this and catch you all in no time!"

Perhaps because she had hidden under the coffee table last time, Xu Youyu figured no one would copy her, so she didn't check there.

She did, however, feel the single armchair. When she didn't find Zhao Rongjun, she assumed he had hidden properly this time, so she didn't bother checking the long sofa next to it.

Qiao Xinyan and Zhao Rongjun had successfully survived the first sweep.

But the three people by the curtains were in trouble.

As Xu Youyu fumbled her way closer, she approached the curtains.

Yan Zhusheng, on the very outside, couldn't help but take half a step back, inadvertently pressing herself into Li Luo's chest.

And Ying Chanxi, in the very back, was pressed hard by Li Luo's back, becoming plastered against him.

Li Luo felt squeezed from both front and back. He froze on the spot, unsure how to react.

When Xu Youyu finally reached the curtains and began to feel inside, Yan Zhusheng instinctively squatted down, her head sliding down along Li Luo's chest.

Fortunately, Li Luo reacted quickly enough. He also squatted down swiftly, catching Yan Zhusheng's head before she could cause a major disaster.

Xu Youyu's hand happened to pass over Li Luo's head, not quite reaching Ying Chanxi in the back.

But Li Luo, who was half-squatting, felt the back of his head land safely on a soft lawn.

When he realized what it was, he was momentarily unsure how he should react.

Ying Chanxi's face was also bright red at this moment.

But with Xu Youyu's threat so close, she didn't dare make any extra movements. She could only hold her breath, hug Li Luo's head tightly, and stare nervously at Xu Youyu outside the curtains.

And so, a very interesting scene formed inside the curtains.

Yan Zhusheng was squatting in the front, her entire body leaning against Li Luo.

Li Luo was half-squatting, his head resting on Ying Chanxi's chest.

The heights of the three people formed a tiered slope, perfectly evading Xu Youyu's first wave of probing.

Unfortunately, there was only so much space behind the curtains. When Xu Youyu searched forward again, her hand hadn't even touched Ying Chanxi when she felt her foot kick something.

So she instinctively reached down and felt a head of soft, long hair.

She took off her blindfold and looked. When she saw the scene before her, she was instantly dumbfounded.

"Wait... what are you three doing?"

"Phew..." As soon as Li Luo saw that Yan Zhusheng was caught, he quickly pulled her up, then got up himself and escaped from the curtains. "It's all their fault for insisting on squeezing me in the middle."

"How was I supposed to know Zhusheng would come in too?" Ying Chanxi said, holding her forehead in exasperation.

But Yan Zhusheng just said seriously, "I felt it was safer where you were."

"You guys are something else," Xu Youyu said, her eye twitching. She took the lipstick and drew a line on Yan Zhusheng's cheek. "It's your turn now, Zhusheng."

"Oh."

Yan Zhusheng nodded and took the blindfold.

But perhaps because her head was a bit small, Yan Zhusheng felt the blindfold was a little loose.

After putting it on, there was actually a gap at the bottom.

If she wanted to, she could see the situation in front of her through the gap at any time.

And so.

After the thirty-second alarm rang.

Yan Zhusheng first pretended to wander around the living room for a bit, then walked straight to the sofa.

The next second.

Amid everyone's gasps, Yan Zhusheng was lightly tripped by the leg of the coffee table, and she fell right onto the single armchair.

And having decided to learn from Zhao Rongjun's excellent philosophy that "the most dangerous place is the safest place," Li Luo was sitting right there, out in the open.

He ended up with Yan Zhusheng falling right into his arms.

"Hiss..." The impact hurt Li Luo a little. He held Yan Zhusheng's body and sucked in a sharp breath. "A-are you okay?"

"Mmm..." Yan Zhusheng hugged Li Luo tightly and didn't move for a long time. It wasn't until the blindfold was taken off that she seemed to belatedly realize what had happened and climbed off of him. "I bumped my foot."

(End of Chapter)
